about_the_game:
Economy world is a real-time strategy where, together with other players, you try to gain the widest possible market share for your products. You start with simple grain production or mining resources in a mine and try to reach the top, which are bakeries, car or computer factories. It is up to you what direction your company will go. The game has a natural supply and demand game, so other players have an impact on the profits we earn. The raw materials we need can be on different continents, then we will be forced to build ports and buy ships that we will transport to our factories.

Players who join companies take part in seasonal rankings, at the end of which they receive prizes thanks to which we will develop our company. The company offers a whole range of tasks to perform as well as bonuses thanks to which we will multiply our profits.

The cars you start the game with are from the 50s, with the development of technology you will have access to more modern trucks with better parameters. We can combine vehicles into convoys thanks to which managing a huge fleet is not a problem. Cars have a wide range of modifications, but first you need to earn points to strengthen them.
